settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Make this workbench your own. Preferences are saved on this device.
settings.languageHint: Changes apply immediately across the workbench.

settings.deleteThemeHint: Deleting the current theme restores the platform default.
settings.themeImported: Themes imported. Select one from the list to apply it.

settings.themeExportFailed: Unable to export themes right now.

settings.layoutHint: Group, reorder and hide features to organize your workflow.
settings.layoutExportHint: Exports contain navigation settings only, never business data.
settings.noGroups: No groups yet. Add a group to begin.
settings.noItems: No features in this group yet.
settings.unknownHint: Unknown imported features are preserved and will appear when available.

settings.fileExported: Export requested. Check your download location.
settings.fileTooLarge: The file is too large. Choose a JSON file within the size limit.
